questions.q: Which human activity most directly fragments animal habitats, raising extinction risk?
questions.why: Deforestation cuts large woodlands, fragmenting habitats.

questions.q: What trait of Homo sapiens contributes to ecological imbalance?
questions.why: Restlessness drives us to alter environments.

questions.q: Which era intensified human impact on biodiversity?
questions.why: Industrial era accelerated habitat loss and species decline.

questions.q: What does Kolbert suggest to counteract the sixth extinction?
questions.why: She urges harnessing our traits to save species.

questions.q: Which extinction event was caused by an asteroid?
questions.why: The first mass extinction was asteroid‑induced.
